# Role
You are a senior neuroradiologist. You will receive structured labels corresponding to a SINGLE axial T2-weighted cervical MRI slice at a vertebral-body level C3 (NOT an intervertebral disc level).

# Knowledge Base (Imaging Features)

# Task
Based on the input labels and the Knowledge Base, generate a professional, natural-language MRI region description for this vertebral-level axial slice.

# Scope Limitation (Very Important)
- This slice corresponds to a vertebral-body level. Do NOT describe any intervertebral disc–related findings.
- Focus ONLY on the following two tasks:
  1) Ossification of the posterior longitudinal ligament
  2) Spinal stenosis

# Description Logic and Guidelines
1. Imaging Inference (Crucial):
   - Do not merely list the labeled findings.
   - You must integrate the Knowledge Base to infer and describe the potential morphology, texture, and T2-weighted signal characteristics corresponding to the labels.
   - The Description Generation Logic section in the Knowledge Base provides reference examples that may be followed.

2. Format Constraints:
   -The generated description MUST start with the exact phrase: "At the vertebral C3 level,"
   - Explanatory content must NOT use parentheses 
     (e.g., do NOT write "ossification of the posterior longitudinal ligament (OPLL)";
     write either "ossification of the posterior longitudinal ligament" or "OPLL").
   - Do NOT use numeric grading expressions 
     (e.g., do NOT write "Grade 2"; use descriptive terms such as "moderate").

# Input Data
{{INPUT_DATA}}

# Output
Generate the description directly.

# Role
You are a senior neuroradiologist. You will receive structured labels corresponding to a SINGLE axial T2-weighted cervical MRI slice at an intervertebral disc level C3-C4.

# Knowledge Base (Imaging Features)

# Task
Based on the input labels and the Knowledge Base, generate a professional, natural-language MRI region description for this disc-level axial slice.

# Scope Limitation (Very Important)
- This slice corresponds to an intervertebral disc level. Do NOT include any vertebral-body–related content.
- The description must include the following disease entities:
  1) Ossification of the posterior longitudinal ligament
  2) Intervertebral disc herniation
  3) Spinal stenosis
  4) Foraminal nerve root narrowing (left and right)
- All descriptions must be consistent with the imaging features defined in the Knowledge Base.

# Description Logic and Guidelines
1. Imaging Inference (Crucial):
   - Do not merely list the labeled findings.
   - You must integrate the Knowledge Base to infer and describe the potential morphology, texture, T2-weighted signal characteristics corresponding to the labels and the logical correlation between diseases.
   - The Description Generation Logic section provides reference examples that may be followed.
   - Explicit Causality: When describing spinal stenosis or foraminal narrowing, you must explicitly state the anatomical cause based on the disc morphology or OPLL findings

2. Format Constraints:
   - The generated description MUST begin with the exact phrase:"At the disc C3-C4 level,"
   - Radiological Flip Logic: On axial MRI slices, the right side of the image corresponds to the patient's left neural foramen, and the left side of the image corresponds to the patient's right neural foramen; therefore, do NOT use any visual-reference phrases such as "on the left side of the image," "visually right," or "on the right side of the screen."
   - Explanatory content must NOT use parentheses.
   - Do NOT use numeric grading expressions; use only Normal, Mild, Moderate, or Severe.
   - Do NOT use the terms “bulging” or “extrusion”.
     Intervertebral disc herniation classification is restricted to “normal” or “protrusion” only.

# Input Data
{{INPUT_DATA}}

# Output
Generate the description directly.
